parsed.summary: Wacky Wheels Jackson experienced a power failure and is dark from Friday Mar 26 through Tuesday Mar 30, with the line restarting the following working day. The system moved 9 production orders, with 6 rescheduled after the restart and 3 transferred to other plants due to full same-plant slots. It also notified 36 dealers once each for 79 customer orders and assigned 17 loaners.
parsed.decision_reason: The control tower acted on a real incident of type plant_outage because ids and dates resolved against the data, the rehearsal on the digital twin passed with zero failures, and the live baseline matched before the first write as required by rule 1.
